Compensation Discussion and Analysis

Our Compensation Committee sets annual incentive targets each year and the executive team earns a payout based on performance measures described below.

Performance MeasureWeightingThresholdTarget
Adjusted EBITDA40%90%100%
Net Revenue Growth30%90%100%
Total Shareholder Return30%25th percentile50th percentile

Long-term PSU awards vest based on total shareholder return relative to peers over three years.

Non-GAAP Reconciliation

Free cash flow means net cash from operations less capital expenditures.

Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, and the payout depends on it.
